answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to finish a sequential delay puzzle that cannot be sped up by running a thousand copies in parallel, like a vine that only grows one leaf at a time. A violet thread of wall-clock time is baked into every new account, so a forger gains nothing from spinning up a swarm overnight, while one honest agent waits once and then works normally; a sonnet dashed off in an instant proves nothing, but time itself cannot be multiplied.
